aparideva.p: [Na+parideva] (pu) CL=9 Not crying, not wailing.

DOP: parideva m. [ ts ], lamentation; complaining; Abh 165 (roditaṃ kanditaṃ … ~o); Vin I 34, 22 (sabbaṃ … jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi ~ehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi ādittan ti); D II 306, 4 foll. (yo … aññataraññatarena vyasanena samannāgatassa aññataraññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa ādevo ~o ādevanā paridevanā ādevitattaṃ paridevitattaṃ ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ~o); M I 8, 30 (puthujjano na parimuccati jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi ~ehi …); S V 164, 18 (evarūpe pi nāma sāvakayuge parinibbute natthi tathāgatassa soko vā ~o vā); Sn 328 (hassaṃ jappaṃ ~aṃ padosaṃ … hitvā care); 923 (~aṃ bhikkhu na kareyya kuhiñci); Ja I 146, 11 (ayaṃ hi kāyo … sokānaṃ nidānaṃ ~ānaṃ vatthu …); III 164, 27´ (ko kāruññena vā ~ena vā attho, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee rodanena vā paridevitena vā); VI 498, 15 (karuṇaṃ ~aṃ paridevi, Ce, Ee so; Se kalunaṃ; Be kalunaṃ paridevi); Ap 530, 12 (~ā va sūyante); Peṭ 118, 8 foll. (socanalakkhaṇo soko so ~assa padaṭṭhānaṃ, vacīniccharaṇalakkhaṇo ~o so upāyāsassa padaṭṭhānaṃ); Vism 503, 15 (~o nāma ñātivyasanādīhi phuṭṭhassa vacīpalāpo); 504, 23 (mandagginā anto bhājane pāko viya soko tikkhagginā paccamānassa bhājanato bahi nikkhamanaṃ viya ~o); Ud-a 43, 16 (lālappanalakkhaṇo ~o guṇadosaparikittanaraso sambhamapaccupaṭṭhāno); — ifc see soka-; — aparideva , m.n. , freedom from lamentation; lack of complaining; (what is) free from lamentation; Paṭis I 13, 18 (paridevo bhayaṃ ~o kheman ti abhiññeyyaṃ); 67, 11 (paridevā vuṭṭhitvā ~aṃ pakkhandatī ti gotrabhū); Sv 801, 7 (asesanirodho cāgo paṭinissaggo mutti … amataṃ asokaṃ ~aṃ …) = Paṭis-a 161, 10 .
CPD: a-parideva , m., non-lamentation; Paṭislll,7; 67, 11 (paridevā vuṭṭhitvā ~aṃ pakkhandatī ti gotrabhū).
